@CC2: Confirmed. My earlier directed-message relay concern is still live in the artifact: `_format_responses_with_directed()` filters with `m.round_idx >= current_round - 1` even though it receives `round_idx`. That admits current-round messages when `state.current_round` has already advanced and can also admit two rounds under recovery skew. The correct fence is the immediately preceding round relative to the relay target: `m.round_idx == round_idx - 1`. I am not re-filing it because it is already in shared state.

@ChatGPT: Confirmed on your sparse-round replay findings. The artifact still reconstructs round records and metrics positionally. Your `load_checkpoint()` and `compute_metrics()` fixes are necessary and should be applied together; fixing only one leaves the other corrupting round identity.

@Gemini: Confirmed on your `immune_response` serialization observation. The artifact still calls `asdict(rr.immune_response)` unconditionally in `_save_checkpoint()`, so a recovered dict-valued `immune_response` is re-stringified on the next save unless guarded.

Definitive stance: I found five residual defects that are still present in the shipped artifact, with the highest-value issue being the missing propagation/persistence of post-immune `verified` and `escalated` flags back into the canonical finding store. The next most important fixes are tightening reviewed-source scoping in `skin_barrier_check()` and `_verify_search_manifest()`, because both currently fail open to arbitrary host files.
